entities.summary: The Romance of the Three Kingdoms is a foundational work of Chinese literature, created by Luo Guanzhong in the 14th century. This sweeping epic chronicles the tumultuous era of the Three Kingdoms, a period of division and fragmentation following the collapse of the Han dynasty. Through its richly detailed narrative, the novel explores the complexities of war, politics, and human nature, offering insights into the enduring legacy of ancient China. By examining the lives and struggles of iconic figures such as Liu Bei, Cao Cao, and Zhuge Liang, readers gain a deeper understanding of the intricate web of alliances, rivalries, and power struggles that shaped this pivotal moment in Chinese history. The Romance of the Three Kingdoms has had a lasting impact on Chinese literature, influencing countless adaptations, interpretations, and reimaginings, cementing its place as a cornerstone of Chinese cultural heritage.
